name: modernslides
description: This is a modern, very computationally light slideshow maker. It completely separates style rules from content. You can edit it completely online or download the code from github.com/kevincure/ModernSlides  or find more similar tools at kevinbryanecon.com/tools.html  and create your slides locally in your browser. Once your slides are set, click Download. You can upload that json file anywhere and open it with a URL query of the form ?deck=.... For example: https://kevinbryanecon.com/ModernSlides/?deck=Progress2025Class1.  I just toss my slides (in subfolders), the index.html Modern Slides program, and the style-gallery on my website and now never need a USB key. The site loads packages and fonts from the internet in real time.
